qa_pairs.question: What is the first step when mounting tires with a modern mounting machine?
qa_pairs.answer: Unscrew valve and deflate the tire.

qa_pairs.question: How should the tire beads be pressed off the rim flange?
qa_pairs.answer: Press off tire bead from rim flange all around on outside and inside with pressing-off horn of the machine.

qa_pairs.question: What should you do if tire beads fit too tight during removal?
qa_pairs.answer: First only loosen tire from flange at several points with the pressing-off horn prior to the actual pressing-off.

qa_pairs.question: How far should the tire beads be pushed into the rim well?
qa_pairs.answer: Push both tire beads into rim well completely until they are loose.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done to the rim after removing the tire?
qa_pairs.answer: Pull off balance weights on rim and clean rim to remove large pieces of dirt.

qa_pairs.question: What should be applied to tire beads before mounting?
qa_pairs.answer: Coat tire beads with mounting paste.

qa_pairs.question: Which direction should the narrow rim shoulder always face when mounting?
qa_pairs.answer: Narrow rim shoulder always faces up.

qa_pairs.question: What distance should the valve be positioned from the right of the mounting head?
qa_pairs.answer: Valve should be at about 10 cm (4") to the right of the mounting head.

qa_pairs.question: What type of tire irons should be used for aluminum rims?
qa_pairs.answer: Use coated or shrink-fit hose covered tire irons for aluminum rims.

qa_pairs.question: In which direction should the mounting machine run back initially to allow the tire bead to slide onto the mounting finger?
qa_pairs.answer: Let mounting machine run back a short distance (counterclockwise) so that the tire bead can slide fully on to the mounting finger.

qa_pairs.question: What should be checked when the mounting machine runs forward briefly?
qa_pairs.answer: Always check whether the bottom bead is fully in the well and the tire is given enough time to move.

qa_pairs.question: What is the final step to achieve complete separation of the tire from the rim?
qa_pairs.answer: Let machine run back a short distance again and then forward (clockwise) briefly, until there is complete separation of the tire from the rim.
